mapper.select: SELECT tr.team_result_id, tr.team_entry_id, tr.item_id, tr.score, tr.rank, tr.create_time FROM team_result AS tr WHERE tr.item_id = #{itemId} AND tr.del_flag = 0 ORDER BY tr.score DESC
SELECT tr.team_result_id, tr.team_entry_id, tr.item_id, tr.score, tr.rank, tr.create_time FROM team_result AS tr WHERE tr.meeting_id = #{meetingId} AND tr.del_flag = 0 ORDER BY tr.score DESC
